question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

I had a (toddler) at home and two other children at school.
solution:
The correct answer is "**newborn**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence mentions that the speaker has a toddler at home and two other children at school.
 
• A toddler refers to a young child who is just learning to walk and is typically between the ages of one and three years old.
 
• Therefore, the **word that is similar in meaning to toddler is newborn, which refers to a recently born baby or infant**.(नवजात)
 
 
• Example: She's incapable of looking after a newborn.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, ancient, means very old or having existed for a long time.(प्राचीन
 
• Option 2, adult, refers to a fully grown person who has reached maturity.(वयस्क)
 
• Option 4, senior, can mean either an older person or someone in a higher position of authority.(वरिष्ठ)
